race.comment: Competitive race and you might know your fate early with DAVIDA (2). Her past two she's stepped slowly and it's effectively been game over from there for a horse who likes to lead and run along in control. She looked stiff last start at Flemington when badly held up for runs. Blake Shinn on is a huge positive, if he can be aggressive early she'll take running down. JENNI MULTABELLA (6) is a progressive mare who looked good stepping up to 1400m at Sandown Hillside second up, really coming away nicely late to score by 1.5 lengths. She's got plenty of upside and can go again with the extra 100m in her favour. LAKE VOSTOK (3) has been okay in two runs back, both in slightly harder company. She can improve and figure in the finish. HI VAL (8) won well enough in 3yo fillies grade last time. She gets in nicely here and can go on with it. CAT NOIR (9) is racing consistently and can figure again.
